title: Newly Naan Turkish Turkey Mince Turkish Kazandibi
description: A fresh and fluffy Turkish dish featuring turkey mince, perfect for a date night. A twist on traditional Turkish kazandibi, made in a bento box for an elegant presentation.
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a bento box over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the turkey mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the ferment-jang, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
If using yogurt, stir it in at this point.
Transfer the mixture to a small bowl and set aside to cool slightly.
Divide the mixture into 4-6 portions, depending on serving size.
Shape each portion into a small patty or oval shape.
Place the patties in the bento box and cover with a lid.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the turkey is cooked through and the mixture is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and your choice of sides.
